title: Residue field of a quotient local ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be ideals. The canonical third-isomorphism map identifies the residue quotient $$(A/I)/(\mathfrak m/I)$$ with $A/\mathfrak m$ as rings (equivalently, $((A\mathbin{\!\slash\!} I)\mathbin{\!\slash\!}\operatorname{map}(I\to A/I,\mathfrak m))\cong A/\mathfrak m$).
